 WARNING  the vault's folder can be read by other accounts on
          this machine
          /srv/shared/sennit
  It lets in every account on this machine, since its mode is
  0755. Sennit keeps every file it makes there for this account
  alone, but the folder shows what is there, and a file another
  program puts in it takes the folder's access. Sennit did not
  make this folder, so it leaves it as it was set.

 HINT     `chmod 700 /srv/shared/sennit` makes it yours alone
